k-anthropic.title: Anthropic IPO ticker coins
k-anthropic.sourceSays: Posts say Anthropic priced a record IPO at $83 a share and began trading on Nasdaq as ANT on Nov 19; coins named Anthropic or ANT appeared afterward and are unverified namesakes.
k-anthropic.reason: Posts of Nov 19 describe the Anthropic IPO and the ANT ticker; the clanker coins opened hours ago, after the event, and are not shown to be official.

k-agent.reason: Posts are paid-style shills of Agent Zero on BSC, call-group multiple claims, and a person-coin story about a different Solana $ZERO; no story behind the shared word agent.
